title: Fix: the header that lost its value
hints: Only headers whose value contains a `:` of its own go wrong (`Host: example.com:8080`, a URL, a time of day). Which colon does the function cut at for those?
The split point comes from `strrchr`, which finds the **last** occurrence of a character. A header name can't contain a colon but a value can, so the split has to happen at the first one.
Swap `strrchr(line, ':')` for `strchr(line, ':')`, which returns a pointer to the first `:`.
